title: Strict quotient representatives, resolutions and pulled augmentation data
statement:
Let $X,Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $(A,I)$ be the Noetherian adic coefficient datum of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. For $T=X,Y$, use its small pro-etale site and completed ring sheaf $B_T=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A/I^n)_T$ from that datum. Put $\mathcal M_T=\operatorname{Mod}(B_T)$, using [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $\operatorname{Tow}_T=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal M_T)$, using [def-weil-inverse-system]. All complexes are unbounded cochain complexes. Tensor products are the sheaf tensor products of [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product].

Define a K-flat flat-term representative over $B_T$ to be the data of a complex $P$ in $\mathcal M_T$, a proof that $P$ is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex], and a proof that each term $P^q$ is flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. This data alone includes no chosen object of the derived category or identification with it.

Let $\Delta_TP$ be the strict constant tower complex with identity transitions. Let $R_T(P)$ be the actual strict quotient complex of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], with level $P\otimes_{B_T}(A/I^n)_T$ (regarded as a $B_T$-module) and transitions induced by the quotient maps. Let $a_P:\Delta_TP\to R_T(P)$ be the chain map whose levelwise section formula is $x\mapsto x\otimes1$. The coefficient-first tensor presentation writes this same scalar-extension map as $x\mapsto1\otimes x$.

For a K-flat flat-term representative $P$ over $B_X$, define a strict quotient resolution to be the data of a complex $H$ in $\operatorname{Tow}_X$, a quasi-isomorphism $r:H\to R_X(P)$, a proof that every evaluated complex $H_n$ is K-flat, and a proof that every term $H_n^q$ is flat. No lift of $a_P$ to $H$ is included, and no flatness or K-flatness of $R_X(P)$ is required.

For $g:Y\to X$, let $G$ be the projection-defined ordinary completed module pullback of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Define $G_C^{\mathrm{Tow}}$ on strict tower complexes by applying $G$ levelwise and degreewise, to differentials and transitions as well as objects. Let $Q_T^{\mathrm{Tow}}$ be the derived localizations of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Given any functor $L_t:D(\operatorname{Tow}_X)\to D(\operatorname{Tow}_Y)$, any K-flat flat-term representative $P$ over $B_X$, and a specified isomorphism $\delta:L_t(Q_X^{\mathrm{Tow}}\Delta_XP)\xrightarrow{\sim}Q_Y^{\mathrm{Tow}}G_C^{\mathrm{Tow}}(\Delta_XP)$, define the transported pulled augmentation to be the actual composite
$$w_{P,\delta}=L_t(Q_X^{\mathrm{Tow}}a_P)\circ\delta^{-1}:Q_Y^{\mathrm{Tow}}G_C^{\mathrm{Tow}}(\Delta_XP)\longrightarrow L_t(Q_X^{\mathrm{Tow}}R_X(P)).$$
No existence or invertibility of a derived counit is asserted by this definition.
